items.title: Gambit Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Become a master of chess, and do it with style! These Gambit Teens are here to rock the board!

*12 chess pros
*2 skins free

items.title: Ancient Flying Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
High up, hidden in between the clouds lies a legendary castle. Many stories have been told about its illustrious history. All alone and abandoned it is yearning for people to return. Step into the past and venture around the castle grounds!

- Survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Masked City Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Roam the streets of the city with your friends! Show off your unique and cool style with fashionable masks!

- 12 skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Heroic Knights
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Put on your armour and wield your sword and shield! Ride on your elegant horse towards countless adventures! Defeat dragons and save your true love! Become the knight you have always wanted to be!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Guardian Of Nether
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The Nether is under siege from outsiders who do not show any respect for those that live in this harsh world. Show these delinquents what it means to incur the wrath of a guardian and show them that the Nether ought to be respected!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Block Party
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Hop on the dance floor, by yourself or with friends! But be careful. One wrong step and you're out! Try to be the last one standing and get the highest score!

- Compatible for Multiplayer mode
- 5 unique arenas
- Unique floor designs
- Power-ups and PvP
- By Team Ignibyte

items.title: Anime Students
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to be an anime character? With skins that are perfect for any adventure, find out what it’s like with these adorable themed skins! Perfect for High School, University, or fun times around the city. So what are you waiting for, grab your friends and rule the school with the Anime Students skin pack!

~Roleplay as teens

items.title: Festive Helpers
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Snow, presents, amazing food, and hot chocolate to keep warm are just a few of the things to look forward to during the festive season! Grab your friends, play in the snow, and stay warm in your favorite festive outfit. With Sparkling lights and fresh snowfall decorating your city, get ready for the merriest time of the year with the Festive Helpers skin pack!

items.title: Beast Island
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description:
Escape the city to Beast Island. Includes modern mansion with custom furniture, a helicopter, interactive house features, and much more!

By Project Moonboot

items.title: Escape the Jungle Temple
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
You've fallen down a deep hole and find yourself in a mysterious jungle temple!

Explore these ancient ruins but make sure you avoid the traps!

There are also rumors that giant crabs lurk in this abandoned dungeon!

Can you escape this long-lost ruins and make it out alive?

Download this exclusive Minecraft dungeon-crawler map and find out now!

items.title: Falling Blocks
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Falling Blocks is a fun mini-game where the ground starts to fall and your mission is to survive! 

- Level up to unlock various cosmetics and look stylish.
- Choose from three difficulties and prove your skills.
- Survive as long as possible to earn more points!

Challenge your friends and become the true master of the blocks!

items.title: Teen Style
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Are you keeping up with the latest fashion trends? Pick up the latest in luxury clothing and fashion brands with the 'Teen Style' skin set!

- 8 different skins!
- Wide variety of clothing styles!

items.title: Incredible Horses
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
A vanilla survival spawn mod map with even more horses! These new horses have bright colors, horns, and wings. They are animated, spawn in the wild, can be tamed, mounted and bred. Some even have special abilities! See if you can find them all!
+ 36 additional horse types 
+ New horse models

items.title: Mining Challenge
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Welcome to the ultimate Mining Challenge! Deep in the dark, there are precious gems to be mined up. Play for high scores, or race against your friends to see who can overcome the mobs and bring home the treasure! Lucky blocks are there to help or hinder. See what you get!
+ Sounds and music
+ Multiple maps

items.title: City
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
City is a roleplaying map bustling with activities and things to do. 
+ Go shopping! Various vendors have fun items for you!
+ Take a taxi!
+ Catch burglars, deliver goods, and drive people!
+ Drive various vehicles with different sizes, speeds, and handling.
+ Dozens of custom models, textures, and voice acting

items.title: Scary Super Monsters
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Choose anyone of the these Scary Super Monsters outfits for your next galactic Minecraft adventure!


By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Mob Animatronics
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Mob Animatronics are here to destroy everything in their sight! These epic mob themed animatronics are great for PvP, PvE and role-playing in Minecraft. Choose any animatronic styled mob and feel the power!

+ Mob Animatronic skin pack
+ Scary animatronic styled outfits
+ Perfect for role-playing
+ Horror
+ Scary

Mob Animatronics by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Scary Monsters vs Pros
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Choose between a scary monster or a pro skin for your next Minecraft adventure!

- Great for roleplay

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Lost Neko
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Nekos are lost in the Minecraft worlds. They need your help to return back to their anime dimension but first, they want to explore the Minecraft dimension.

- 21 cute lost neko skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Ancient Egypt
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to the Ancient world! Roleplay as an Egyptian from the world's past! Explore the pyramids of your mind and conquer treasure abroad!

+ 10 Egyptian themed skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Dragon Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Roleplay as a dragon teen! Firey breath not included!

items.title: 80s Fashion
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to the 80s! It's groovy dudes! Prepare to get far out, man!

+ 15 roleplay-ready skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Farm Life
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Welcome to life on a farm! Grab a shovel and get to the fields and start working!

items.title: Teen Flower Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Everyone needs an outfit made from the freshest flowers for the Spring season. This skin pack comes with 14 awesome modern kawaii outfits, that range from neon rainbows to pastel floral patterns and many other dream styles! Which anime inspired look will you choose?

- 14 trendy skins
- Includes 1 free skin
- Perfect for everyone
